expected.given: The unchanged public six-fact fixture is loaded. Also exercise separate in-memory data with one fact containing multiple contradiction references and another fact with none.
expected.when: Open the session and select each filter, then All.
expected.then: All is initially selected with count 6; Contradictions has count 2 and only fixture positions 2,4; Unsupported has count 3 and only positions 3,4,5; All restores positions 1 through 6. In the separate multiple-reference boundary, the contradiction count is exactly 1 and exactly one card renders, regardless of reference count.
expected.forbidden: Disjoint categorization, pair counting, sorted results or hardcoded production counts.
counterexamples: A fact in both categories must appear once in each corresponding view.

expected.when: Navigate to another session while the page remains mounted and destination query data is cached, observe the first destination render, then return to the first session.
expected.then: The first destination render already selects All and shows every destination fact in order with accurate counts; no frame applies the previous filter. Every subsequent session change also starts at All.
expected.forbidden: A previous session filter leaking into another session.
counterexamples: Rendering a cached destination session as Unsupported fails.
